title: Oracle style · Aptitude, CS fundamentals + Coding
description: Aptitude and computer science MCQs, then coding. 30 MCQs + 2 coding problems in 90 minutes. Original practice questions modelled on the publicly reported test pattern. Not an official or past paper.

questions.text:
Study the table and answer.

Year | Produced (units) | Sold (units)
2021 | 370 | 360
2022 | 250 | 240
2023 | 350 | 315
2024 | 380 | 320
2025 | 140 | 75

What is the average number of units sold per year?
questions.explanation: Total sold = 1310; ÷ 5 = 262.

questions.text: What is the difference between compound interest and simple interest on Rs 16000 at 15% per annum for 2 years?
questions.explanation: CI = 5160, SI = 4800, difference = Rs 360.

questions.text: A starts a business with Rs 5000. After 6 months B joins with Rs 5000. At the end of the year the profit is Rs 300. What is B's share?
What is the sum of the first 30 terms of the series 6, 12, 18, ...?
What is the remainder when 3^47 is divided by 9?
questions.explanation: Powers of 3 mod 9 cycle; 3^47 mod 9 = 0.

questions.text: What comes next: CX, FU, IR, LO, ?
questions.explanation: First letters move +3; second letters move −3 from the other end of the alphabet.

questions.text: What comes next: EV, GT, IR, KP, ?
questions.explanation: First letters move +2; second letters move −2 from the other end of the alphabet.

questions.text:
Statements: Some chairs are trees. No trees is cats.
Conclusion: Some chairs are not cats.
Does the conclusion follow?
questions.explanation: Draw the Venn diagram for the statements: the conclusion must hold in every possible case.

questions.text: Which number is the odd one out: 64, 324, 289, 327?
questions.explanation: 327 — all others are perfect squares.

questions.text: A cube painted on all faces is cut into 125 identical small cubes. How many small cubes have no faces painted?
questions.explanation: For an n×n×n cube (n = 5): 3 faces: 8, 2 faces: 12(n−2), 1 face: 6(n−2)², none: (n−2)³ → 27.

questions.text: Which is a NoSQL database?
questions.explanation: MongoDB stores documents.

questions.text: Which sorting algorithm has worst-case O(n log n) time?
questions.explanation: Quick sort's worst case is O(n²).

questions.text: Which principle says a class should have only one reason to change?
questions.explanation: S in SOLID.

questions.text: Which is an example of an operating system?
questions.explanation: Linux manages hardware and processes.

questions.text: In Java, which keyword is used to inherit from a class?
questions.explanation: Classes use extends; interfaces use implements.

questions.text: Which data structure is best for a breadth-first search?
questions.explanation: BFS processes nodes in FIFO order.

questions.text: An index on a column mainly helps to
options: speed up searches on that column
questions.explanation: Indexes trade write cost and space for faster reads.

questions.text: Accessing an array element by index takes
questions.explanation: Index arithmetic gives direct access.

questions.text: Which collection in Java does not allow duplicate elements?
questions.explanation: Sets store unique elements.

questions.text: HTTP status 404 means
questions.explanation: The resource does not exist.

questions.text: Which of these is a symmetric encryption algorithm?
questions.explanation: AES uses one shared key; SHA is a hash.

questions.text: Which SQL command removes all rows but keeps the table structure, and is usually faster than DELETE?
questions.explanation: TRUNCATE empties the table; DROP deletes the table itself.

questions.text:
What is the output of this pseudocode?

s = 0
for i = 1 to 18 step 2
    s = s + i * i
end for
print s
questions.explanation: The loop takes i = 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, 13, 15, 17; the result is 969.

questions.text:
What is the output? (div = integer division)

n = 3487
s = 0
while n > 0
    s = s + (n mod 10)
    n = n div 10
end while
print s
questions.explanation: Trace the loop digit by digit.

questions.text:
What is the output? (div = integer division)

n = 1574
r = 0
while n > 0
    r = r * 10 + (n mod 10)
    n = n div 10
end while
print r
questions.explanation: Trace the loop digit by digit.

questions.text: Given the function f(n) = 1 if n == 0 else 2 * f(n - 1), what is f(7)?
questions.explanation: Expanding the recursion gives f(7) = 128.

questions.title: Range sum queries
questions.text:
Given an array and q queries ‘l r’ (1-based, inclusive), print the sum of a[l..r] for each query on its own line.

Input: first line n and q (1 ≤ n, q ≤ 10^5); second line n integers (|a[i]| ≤ 10^4); then q lines ‘l r’ (1 ≤ l ≤ r ≤ n).
Output: q lines.

starterCode.python:
import sys

data = sys.stdin.read().split()
# write your code here
starterCode.javascript:
const data = require('fs').readFileSync(0, 'utf8').trim().split(/\s+/);
// write your code here

questions.explanation: Reference approach: see the standard technique for ‘Range sum queries’.
